title: What a vending route actually clears in a year
author: coinop

comments.author: ledgerline
comments.text: Refreshing to see real numbers instead of a course being sold. The spoilage line is what surprised me: nearly a tenth of product cost on the snack machines.

replies.author: coinop
replies.text: Author here. That was the lesson of the first year. Placement matters more than product mix, and a machine nobody walks past spoils everything in it.

comments.author: routeplanner
comments.text: The fuel and time costs are the part people leave out. Your hourly rate once you count restocking drives is lower than the headline margin suggests.

replies.author: coinop
replies.text: Yes, and I say so in the table: counting drive time it came to a little under what I was paid at my day job. It is a second income, not a first.

comments.author: tokenring
comments.text: Glad the stewards restored this. It was flagged within an hour of going up, which says more about the blogspam in this category than about the piece.
